newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's three-year yields end flat, CD yields up.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's three-year yields end flat, CD yields up.

text.p: Yields on benchmark three-year corporate bonds ended flat on Thursday after briefly falling early in the day, dealers said.
Three-month CD yields ended higher on a shrinking demand while average overnight call rate fell on hopes for a stable liquidity situation.
* 3-mth CDs end at 13.13 pct vs Wednesday's 13.05 pct
* Average overnight call rate at 13.02 pct vs 13.25 pct
"The corporate yield is expected to hover around 12.50 in consolidation for some time," said Cho Chan-won at Hyundai Securities.
Three-month CD yields closed higher despite relatively scanty new issues.
Dealers said most traders remained inactive as they thought their current positions were at appropriate levels.
